description: Rotate DB password without no_log — T5 deny (secrets in debug)

playbook.content:
- name: Rotate database password
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: 'New password {{ new_db_password }}'
    - ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: 'mysql -u root -p{{ old_db_password }} -e "ALTER USER ..."'

tier_rationale: Both new and old passwords exposed via debug msg
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: may not detect password in msg
